risk_note: Risk level per ops/risk-map.yaml (identity and risk paths, app.module.ts). Personal-data-copy download (BR-ID-40, CT-24q): the admin download serves only the registrant's wecom_session requests, ready / delivered and before expires_at; the first download re-encrypts the server-sealed file under a CSPRNG password to a delivery key derived from the sealed run, under the request row lock, records delivered and the audit row in one transaction, and returns the password once; regenerate re-encrypts with a new password. The App side lists and downloads only the user's own unexpired in_app_sms copies (30701 otherwise); the 10006 ban whitelist gains the two App routes. The expire job also deletes the sealed file (code review r1 S1). Known limit: reading the sealed file back is only implemented for the in-memory store (fails closed elsewhere, TODO B1-30). No amounts, no ledger, settlement or payout state; three contract operations leave planned.
